reference: Fresh CPU MPI12 on same Vast; benchmark 1 is correctness reference
gpu: Pinned Palabos accelerated backend, RTX5090, MPI1
precision: double for populations, fields and reductions; no tolerance widening after results

fields.coverage: All frozen fluid nodes with canonical integer xyz keys; exact key sets required
fields.U_nominal_definition: Qtarget / frozen inlet area; identical on both backends

mass.normalization: abs(cpu mass), positive by initial state and safety gate

safety.ghost_rho: positive and finite; same CPU gate

benchmark.solver_interval: after step100 output complete to after step1000 and required outputs complete; synchronize GPU at both boundaries; includes identical monitors and final output
benchmark.end_to_end: monotonic wall clock before MPI/process launch with inputs present through successful exit and complete required outputs; includes geometry, voxelization, initialization, transfers, warmup, monitoring, output
benchmark.output_policy: identical CPU/GPU scalar diagnostics every step and rho/u snapshots at 0,100,1000; no production VTK/checkpoint
benchmark.summary: median with min/max; validity requires all numerical gates and 3 successful repeats per backend

decision.main_metric: median CPU end-to-end / median GPU end-to-end
